overview: This batch finalizes the ultra-endgame simulation by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running campaigns and the final ascension logic. These tasks ensure memory stability over 5,500+ ticks and provide a clean, non-blocking exit strategy for the simulation loop.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array<uint8_t, 4096> for static buffers. Implement a simple run-length encoding (RLE) for tick states. No dynamic allocation. Use constexpr for buffer sizes. Ensure all operations are noexcept. The compressor must handle 5,500 ticks within 4KB static memory by collapsing identical consecutive states.
acceptance_criteria: Memory usage remains constant at 4KB regardless of tick count.
Decompression speed is O(N) with N being the number of unique states.
All unit tests pass with 0 heap allocations reported by the profiler.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster load times for long campaigns and stable memory usage on low-end devices.

tasks.title: Finalize Ascension State Machine Transition
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a strict enum class for AscensionStates { Idle, Processing, Complete }. Implement a state machine that transitions from Processing to Complete only when all 16,500 footsteps are logged. Use std::variant for state data to avoid heap fragmentation. Ensure thread-safe transitions using std::atomic<int>.
acceptance_criteria: State transitions are atomic and lock-free.
No deadlocks occur during the transition from tick 5500 to Ascension Complete.
The manager correctly reports 'Complete' status after the final tick.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides a clear, immediate end-of-game signal without hanging the simulation loop.

tasks.title: Generate Deterministic Ascension Summary
tasks.architectural_spec: Create a struct AscensionSummary with fixed-size char arrays for stats. Populate it with tick count, footstep count, and survival rate. Use std::format (C++20) for string generation into a static buffer. No dynamic string allocations.
acceptance_criteria: Output is identical across runs for the same seed.
No heap allocations during summary generation.
